messages.author: 132678befc181647
messages.subject: Permutation for CIM
parts:
Karl: 

 

The CIM command works great, but when I attempt to perform permutation, the command “hangs” (i.e., does not execute).  Is this possibly a bug?

 

Below are the commands: 

 

outprocim.em <- cim(OBJNAME, pheno.col=3, n.marcovar=4, window=10, method=c("em"), error.prob=0.001, map.function=c("kosambi"))

summary(outprocim.em)

summary(outprocim.em, threshold=3)

max(outprocim.em)

attr(outprocim.em, "marker.covar")

attr(outprocim.em, "marker.covar.pos")

 

Above cmds work!

Below cmds do not!

 

opermoutprocim.em <- cim(OBJNAME, pheno.col=3, method="em", n.perm=1900)

plot(opermoutprocim.em, main="1900 Permutations (method=em) C0008 F2.3 Seed Protein")

mtext("Composite Interval Analysis (EM Method)", side=3, line=1, las=1)

summary(opermoutprocim.em, alpha=c(0.20,0.10,0.05))

summary(outprocim.em, perms=opermoutprocim.em, alpha=0.05, pvalues=TRUE)

 

Jim

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Permutation for CIM
parts:
Are you sure that it's not executing?
You should expect it to take about 1900x as long as running it without permutations.

Try using n.perm=5 to start.

karl
